entries.title: Free for life — and offline
entries.summary: YahBible is free for life and works fully offline. No paywall on the Word, the original languages, or research. “Buy the truth, and sell it not” (Proverbs 23:23); “freely ye have received, freely give” (Matthew 10:8).

entries.title: Hebrew, Greek & Aramaic word study
entries.summary: Tap any word in the OT or NT for its original Hebrew, Greek or Aramaic, its Strong’s number, transliteration, letter meanings, and every place it is used across Scripture — in-depth study included, and it works offline.

entries.title: The Ten Commandments, taught in colour
entries.summary: Each commandment now reads larger and clearer, with the words of Christ in holographic scarlet (like the red-letter words) and every other quote in violet.

entries.title: Uriel’s Heavenly Design refined
entries.summary: The flat-earth cosmology (2D disc & 3D dome) now renders transparent — only the model and its labels draw, so the sanctuary background shows through.

entries.title: Why YahBible
entries.summary: A new comparison shows how YahBible stands beside other Bible apps: free for life, fully offline, original-language study, the apocrypha, the cosmology, and an AI guide that cites chapter and verse — none of it paywalled.

entries.title: RealizeUS in the app
entries.summary: The bottom-right tab now opens RealizeUS.org right inside YahBible. News & Updates moved to the right menu.

entries.title: Menus rebuilt like the desktop
entries.summary: Left menu = Holy Bible · YHWH The Logos · Torah/OT/NT/Ethiopian/Red Letter, with Gnostic & Questionable accordions and a Download-everything button. Right menu = Settings, News, Repentance, the Ten Commandments.

entries.title: Studio camera controls
entries.summary: Front/back/both cameras, independently movable & pinch-resizable, with border colour (10 incl. holographic), shape, mirror and green-screen — all set in Settings. Gold Aleph-Tav app icon.

entries.title: Tap any word for its Hebrew/Greek
entries.summary: Press the eye on a chapter to show the original under each verse; tap a word for its Strong's number and definition. Download the versions & word-study packs for full offline study.

entries.title: Ten Commandments rewritten as guided questions
entries.summary: Every commandment now opens as a study of clear questions — “What is Adultery?”, “How do you keep this commandment?”, and “How is it broken?” in each of the seven dimensions — organized exactly as the source document.

entries.title: Repentance added as its own category
entries.summary: A dedicated Repentance category now sits above the Ten Commandments, and every commandment gained a Repentance section — the inward ladder, per-dimension turning, Seek Counsel in Prayer, and the full Lord's Prayer.

entries.title: The human-dimension diagram
entries.summary: An interactive figure of seven nested layers — Physical on the surface to Spiritual at the core. Click any layer to open its dimension and see where sin forms inwardly before it appears in the body.

entries.title: Offline English dictionary
entries.summary: 147,000+ English definitions now work with no internet, alongside the Hebrew/Greek original-language word study.

entries.title: Offline reading voice
entries.summary: Scripture and word studies can be read aloud entirely offline.

entries.title: Profiles & reading progress
entries.summary: Track how much of Scripture you have read, keep notes and bookmarks, and carry them across your devices on the Zion'iel Network.
